risk_note: RV2 (ledger). The ledger module posting service (BR-FUND-10, 13, 16): openUserAccount (idempotent user account and balance row), lockBalances (FOR UPDATE on account_balances in ascending account_id; users rows are locked by the caller through identity, ledger-plan D4), post (inside the caller's Kysely transaction under a SAVEPOINT: app_id check, the user accounts must have been locked by this transaction, (app_id, uniq_key) duplicate returns the original voucher (23505 rolls back to the savepoint and reads it back), validateVoucher, applyEntries and mayGoNegative from @couli/domain, voucher + entries with balance_after_fen and account_version, balance cache version+1 with version check, negative_since in and out, platform accounts created lazily and not locked), getBalances. The Clock is read once per transaction for booked_at and the accounting date (D2). User-view balances are the negative of the entry-sign sums (decision 20). Registered in app.module for every entry except stream. Integer fen only.
